rules.title: 계획 승인
rules.rule: source→confirm→draft→human auth→trusted identity→target→server PlanReview→explicit approval→job→worker lease. Plan digest binds source/draft/rule/media + account/slot/environment + ordered steps/permission/adapter. User receives plan, echoes digest; stale/changed scope requires new plan/approval. Do not require client to derive operation IDs.

rules.title: 증거 계층
rules.rule: IdentityObservation is stored before account/target/job. TargetObservation is stored before target/job after verified account; both owner/connection scoped, typed separate from job Evidence. Plan links trusted target observations. Account evidence ref links IdentityObservation; no circular FK.

rules.title: 제어권과 직렬화
rules.rule: human_auth view only; input fenced before system_read, which can only verify identity and resolve existing targets/preflight via trusted operations. human_review state no worker effects; only approved job/lease permits mutation. Worker and human commands pass same gateway. Revoke/cancel/CAS admission single linearization boundary. Adapter never retains raw driver; view disconnect independent. All V3 safety rules mandatory in MVP. A human intervention grant may permit only authentication or user-directed correction within registered scope. Human input that can change external state is not treated as an approved automated effect; before resuming automation, re-observe target/effect and ask for approval if scope changes. Unclassifiable pending effect blocks further automation.

rules.title: 재연결
rules.rule: new connection same owner/platform/env/stable subject; no pending admitted command before new automation. Stop old controller and invalidate old grant/lease/epoch atomically; rebind allowed only needs_action/unknown/blocked with safe observation path (no terminal or running). unknown stays unknown; new session may read reconcile with same target/permission; safe next step evidence + explicit resume + current approval + fresh lease needed. Wrong account no mutation, old job retained.

rules.title: 재접속 UX
rules.rule: service principal authenticates to app; owner list sources/jobs, stored detail and next action; remote grant only authorized phase. UI never guesses completion. user may log in again without resubmitting original data.

rules.title: 한 번 입력·다중 대상
rules.rule: source version shared, platform-specific rule/draft/plan/approval/job separate; sequential jobs default; create target per account/object/slot. Reuse existing confirmed facts/media without retyping, missing fields per platform. New source changes no historic result and stale pending approval only if relevant scope changes; explicitly re-review. Separate platform outcomes.

rules.title: 지원과 실행 판정
rules.rule: registry exact approved host/path/route; unsupported/invalid→no fetch. supported can still be live_blocked/info missing/auth required/target ambiguity/approval missing/unknown. can_dispatch only calculated at internal admission with V3 all guards, user API advisory false until current server validation. mock fixtures map separately, live network disabled; no arbitrary redirects/private network.

rules.title: AI 최소 제품 경로
rules.rule: model receives sanitized source and platform field spec; returns structured candidate facts/mappings/questions/provenance, deterministic schema/units/constraints checks; user confirms substantive facts. Model unavailable/invalid output visibly needs_action, manual confirmed input possible for technical tests but not AI acceptance. AI MVP test raw unstructured lesson text→candidate fields and missing/conflict question→confirmed draft. No fixed-price mock hardcode or invented rule.

rules.title: 목표 및 release 경계
rules.rule: MVP mock: Kmong full first listing receipt readback mandatory; Soomgo confirmed synthetic service configuration second target by 12/8, if not completed R01 replan not falsely pass. Final URL supported platform(s) E2E, one source across Kmong+Soomgo intended baseline. No universal unknown sites. Live target_confirmed transition remains unreachable until separate phase approval after policy, account/eligibility, validated effect/goal evidence, isolation, privacy, user authorization. Future transition candidate running/stopping/unknown→target_confirmed only if live gate approved + platform goal evidence valid + no pending effect; no auto-enabling. If only mock passes, engineering mock verified; actual service objective unverified/not met. Actual scope of Soomgo save/publication remains external gate. MVP includes basic fact proposal and missing/conflict clarification (T5-08) plus per-platform mapping. Product gate can report mock registration pass independently of AI or Soomgo failure; the overall MVP is incomplete until required scope passes or R01 explicitly changes scope. Final operational target not equivalent to a dry run.

rules.title: 최소 구현
rules.rule: 공통 app + persistent store + remote runtime isolation boundary + test harness. Component IDs logical only, config version files or embedded JSON allowed; no message broker/microservices required for MVP. SQLite or PostgreSQL after atomic/owner tests; Python/FastAPI reuse candidate. Browser internal choice delegated. Use stub first, then actual local synthetic adapter and isolated runtime, progressive contract CI. Implementation package root candidate product/lesson-registration/ with app, contracts, adapters, remote, web, tests, fixtures; no files created or common dependencies modified.

rules.title: 최소 실행·개발 환경
rules.rule: One shared contracts/ module, server-owned registry and sample fixtures, app/remote/adapters/web/test modules in product/lesson-registration/ candidate root. W01 freezes wire version, common error codes, contract package and one launch command with fake providers. Implementers can select internal technology; shared transport/dependencies changes require R01 coordination. At minimum shared contract fixtures, provider unit tests, smoke command, lint/CI, mock network allowlist; no common root dependency edit before decision.

route_inheritance: V0.4 HTTP-02,14,15,17 inherit; HTTP-02 multipart MediaRequest + file, HTTP-14/15 StopRequest, HTTP-17 ReadRequest with stored ObjectObservation[]. All other IDs replaced/added by V5. HTTP-07 verify replaces handoff route. All mutations require key (except internal dispatch, bound by durable attempt); path/body ref consistency; owner server principal; GET path/query no body. Standard 401/403/404/409/422/503 and 202 async; Error5Response on errors; never silently retry effect.

contract_wire.transport: public JSON HTTP; private logical ports may be direct typed calls within process or authenticated internal RPC; common request and response shapes identical

primitives.id: opaque nonempty string; generated by server except fixture literals
primitives.array: ordered array; fields with [] are homogeneous

contract_wire.requiredness: required fields must be present and non-null; optional absent rather than null unless explicitly documented; reject unknown fields in versioned contract; semantic error messages separate from machine codes
contract_wire.digest: server builds canonical scope object with sorted object keys recursively, array order preserved (explicit sorted order for set-like refs), UTF-8 JSON no whitespace, integers for currency/minutes/count and decimal values as normalized string, excludes digest itself and ephemeral connection IDs; SHA-256. All hash participants use one shared helper; clients echo server digest, not recompute. Include target_observation_refs only as evidence for target identity at plan creation, not subsequent observation timestamps; stale readback triggers revalidation, not arbitrary change to approved plan. Use explicit canonical field list in shared helper implementation.
contract_wire.step_boundary: one logical effectful action per StepSpec. Read/setup commands may be repeated only if classified read-only and authorized. Single-use effect permit bound to attempt and generation, consumed once before external action. Command dispatch after revocation blocked; previously admitted effect not assumed rollback.
contract_wire.errors: Error5Response; retry_blocked true for pending/unknown or forbidden effect; retry only explicit safe recovery; schema errors not retry instructions
contract_wire.contract_tests: invalid field/enum/unknown property; stale/digest mismatch; same request key; stable effect across plans; command attempts beyond approved spec
contract_wire.security: Service authentication is separate from platform authentication. Local mock may use explicit synthetic service principals with server-side sessions; no client owner header trusted. External production auth, cookie/CSRF, TLS, secrets, retention and egress enforced before live. Browser input during human auth is permitted only for registered origin and grant/phase; human arbitrary mutations outside the task not delegated or classified as completed. If human effect possible, re-observe target; unknown blocks automation.
